# Gaming Reset

> Gaming Reset is a personalised habit-change app for people who want to spend
> less time gaming. New users answer a short series of questions about their
> habits and their routine, and the app turns those answers into a small daily
> plan, then tracks progress automatically so cutting back rests on structure
> rather than willpower.
>
> Gaming Reset is self-improvement and habit-building software. It is not a
> medical or therapeutic service, and it does not provide diagnosis, treatment,
> or professional advice of any kind.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://gamingreset.com/): What Gaming Reset is and how the daily plan works.
- [Plans](https://gamingreset.com/plans): Pricing, the 3 day free trial, and subscription options.
- [Writing](https://gamingreset.com/writing): Essays on gaming habits, the design behind why games are hard to put down, and what actually works to cut back. This index is the canonical, always-current list of articles.
- [Gaming Addiction Statistics](https://gamingreset.com/gaming-addiction-statistics): A sourced statistics reference on how common problem gaming is.
- [Contact](https://gamingreset.com/contact): How to reach the team.

## Notes

- Individual articles are deliberately not enumerated here. This file is
  maintained by hand and would fall out of date every time a post ships. Use
  the /writing index or the sitemap for the current list.
- The dashboard, onboarding, checkout, success, leaderboard, settings, and
  account pages are private authenticated areas. They are marked noindex and
  are not intended for crawling or training.
- Sitemap: https://gamingreset.com/sitemap.xml
